clause_ref: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Section 4 (Scope of PCI DSS Requirements)
clause_path: Section 4: CDE definition, connected-to and impact clauses, storage example, annual scope confirmation, segmentation, data-flow documentation

obligations.label: the cardholder data environment includes system components, people, and processes that store, process, or transmit cardholder data or sensitive authentication data

the cardholder data environment also includes system components with unrestricted connectivity into components that store, process, or transmit account data, even if they never touch the data themselves
the cardholder data environment also includes components, people, and processes that could impact the security of account data
the entity must confirm the accuracy of its PCI DSS scope annually as the first step of assessment preparation
storage of account data in any format, including paper, data files, audio, images, and video recordings, sits in scope
segmentation of the cardholder data environment is not a PCI DSS requirement but is recommended as a method that may reduce scope
account data flows are documented via a data-flow diagram so the entity understands where account data comes in and where it resides
